delege.title: Delege
delege.description: Built in roughly four weeks, Delege connects Moroccan and MENA businesses to a WhatsApp AI agent for around the clock customer conversations. Its stack combines a FastAPI and Celery backend with Redis, a Node.js Baileys bridge, and a Supabase/pgvector retrieval pipeline. The agent supports Arabic, French, Darija, and English; it can also use Shopify data. A responsive Next.js dashboard includes agent configuration, conversations, knowledge files, integrations, and subscription tools. Early development.
delege.delegeAlt: Delege dashboard showing conversation metrics, recent chats, and agent status

airwriter.title: AirWriter
airwriter.description: A browser based air writing canvas that turns webcam hand gestures into a smooth, mirrored writing trackpad, with mouse mode as an alternative. Camera frames stay on the device. Draw, erase, undo, redo, choose colors, tune the gesture controls, and export images with a transparent or camera background.
airwriter.airwriterAlt: AirWriter webcam drawing interface with the camera start and mouse mode options

socra.title: Socra
socra.description: A Socratic AI tutor for university students. Add course PDFs and notes, then work toward an insight through guided questions rather than receiving a direct answer. Responses cite the supplied course material. A bring your own API key setting supports Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic; the app also includes a default Gemini option. Built as a Multi-Agent Systems course capstone at EMSI with Yasser Touil and Youssef Hachimi Alaoui.
socra.socraAlt: Socra Socratic study companion interface with a guided question about course material

mobiconnect.title: End-of-Studies Intern
mobiconnect.description: Built a local Android security audit automation platform combining ADB device checks, MobSF APK analysis, normalized findings, deterministic risk scoring, HTML/PDF reports, and human reviewed AI/RAG remediation. The solution included Docker deployment and n8n workflows.
